(The link expires in about 24 hours.)

**Not done: adding the logo to talk-one.mp4**
- Magic Hour has no tool that places an image on top of a video as an overlay.
- The closest tool is the AI video editor. It redraws every frame from a text prompt, so the speaker, the background and the sound could all change. It also could not place the logo at an exact spot or size. That goes against your request to keep the video and sound unchanged, so I did not run it.
- On the free plan, the editor also cannot take the fox image as a reference. It would only follow a text description of a fox.

**How to finish it without changing the video:** use any simple video editor (CapCut, iMovie, Premiere, Canva) and add the transparent PNG as an image layer:
- Make it about 10–15% of the video width.
- Put it in the top-right corner with a small margin from the edges, about 2–3% of the width.
- Stretch the layer across the full length of the video.
- Export. Your original video and audio stay as they are.

If you have ffmpeg, this one command does the same thing and copies the audio without changing it:
ffmpeg -i talk-one.mp4 -i fox.png -filter_complex "[1]scale=iw*0.12*main_w/iw:-1[l];[0][l]overlay=W-w-24:24" -c:a copy out.mp4

If you want, I can try the AI video editor anyway and describe the fox in text. You should expect the result to look a bit different from your original video.
